title: Sorcerer in the Gloaming
description: A hooded figure in an ornate purple robe stands on a rocky shore at night, holding a lantern in one hand and a flaming torch in the other. Purple smoke rises on the left while thick orange smoke billows above, with skeletal remains and debris scattered across the ground near dark water and trees.
prompt: A lone hooded sorcerer wearing a long flowing purple robe with golden arcane symbols stands on a rocky shoreline at night, back to viewer, holding a glowing lantern in one hand and a burning torch in the other, thick orange smoke rising dramatically into the dark sky, purple ethereal smoke swirling on the left, skeletal remains and tattered cloth scattered on the ground, dark forest and water in background, atmospheric lighting, realistic fantasy style
